entries.zh: 安静、寂静；屋里静得断了人影、毫无声息，好像屋里没有人一样
entries.en: quiet, stillness, calm (sosiego); so still in the house that no trace (shadow) of anyone stirs - as if no one were there
entries.notes: 西语词头展开为 sosiego（宁静），与释义句 quieto no hace ruido alguno, como si no hubiera hombre 及汉字/音写（断人影 tuí-lâng-ià）四栏互证。

entries.zh: 安静、寂静；屋里静得断了人声，全无人声
entries.en: quiet, stillness; no sound of anyone in the house (sosiego en la casa, as if empty of people)
entries.notes: 同上条 sosiego 词族；圈选之 ides 疑为 id est（即）缩写，指向上一条释义，不影响词义。

entries.en: to suspect; to mistrust (sospechar, maliciar)
to guess; to suspect (sospechar)

entries.zh: 惊讶、诧异；列于怀疑（sospechar）条下，或兼有起疑之义
entries.en: to marvel, be surprised; (grouped under) to suspect
entries.notes: 汉字訝本义惊讶而非怀疑，音写 che（tsé）读音亦未确证，与 sospechar 的对应依赖同条词族语境推断。

entries.en: to suspect; to doubt (sospechar)
suspicion; to suspect (sospechar)
to become suspicious; suspicion (sospechar)
entries.notes: 疑得为罕见组合，第二字音写 gay（gái）未能确证为何字，义依 sospechar 条语境定为起疑。

entries.en: doubt, perplexity; to suspect (sospechar)
entries.notes: 官话栏为一混拼样句（含西班牙语 falso fingido 虚假假冒字样，似言这个是假的），仅旁证存疑之语境，不影响词义。

entries.en: suspicion; to suspect (sospechar)

entries.zh: 心思过虑；多思多虑、疑神疑鬼
entries.en: to brood, overthink; anxious pondering and needless suspicion (sospechar, pensar)
original damaged; gloss uncertain (grouped under sospechar/pensar: to suspect, to think)
entries.notes: 汉字栏残缺，音写 hvá-lī 无从确证为何词；仅西语 sospechar、pensar（怀疑/思虑）可存疑参照。

entries.en: to substitute; replace, act in place of (sostituir)
entries.notes: 音写作两音节（thèi-tè）而汉字栏仅替一字，疑衍一音，释义不受影响。

entries.en: to substitute; act in place of (sostituir)

entries.zh: 暂且替代、权且顶替（替权）
entries.en: to substitute for the time being; act as temporary stand-in (sostituir)
entries.notes: 替权组合罕见，据權（权且、暂且）之义与 sostituir 相合推断，如权充、权代。

entries.en: to deputize; substitute temporarily (sostituir)
entries.notes: 西语词头被叉划掉（存废未定），释义依汉字/音写；代权义同上条权且替代。

entries.en: to replace; substitute for (sostituir)
entries.notes: 官话栏残缺，惟西语/汉字/音写三栏互证清晰（代替=sostituir）。

entries.zh: 代代封侯；爵位官职一代传一代地承袭
entries.en: hereditary succession of title or office, generation after generation (a marquisate passing from one life to the next, like a hereditary office)
entries.notes: 汉字栏代下有小字之，音写 tay-tay（代代）封侯；与西语 de vida en vida como el officio（像职役那样一生传一生）相合。

entries.zh: 替手；接替干活的人、顶替者
entries.en: a substitute/helper who takes over another's work (sostituir el trabajo por otro)

entries.zh: 替脚；顶替补位者，局中替人顶名上场
entries.en: a stand-in; substitute filling another's place (in a company or game)
entries.notes: 西语词头尾部残缺（o[残]go，或为 juego），汉字/音写清晰（替脚 thé-ka），释义不受影响。
